samples.summary: Unbounded variadic spread of document-controlled row count (`Math.max(0, ...rows.map(...))`) can throw RangeError on a hostile/large table
samples.evidence: `visitCellRectangleSlices` computes the column clamp as `Math.max(0, ...rows.map((row) => row.cells.length)) - 1`. The spread turns every table row into a separate call argument, so the argument count is bounded only by the document's row count, which is not user-typed data alone: a doc arrives from the Yorkie CRDT (any collaborator) or from DOCX/HTML import. Beyond roughly 100k–125k arguments V8 throws `RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded`. Vector: a collaborator (or a crafted import) creates a table with >~125k rows in a shared doc; the moment a local user makes a cell-rectangle selection there, every `getRangeStyleSummary()` call — which the toolbar runs on each render (packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-format-group.tsx:96) — and `Doc.applyInlineStyleToCells` (packages/docs/src/model/document.ts) throws out of a React render path, taking down the editor UI for the victim rather than just failing the style read. Impact is a client-side availability break only (no data exposure); the fix is a plain reduce/loop over `rows`. Note the same spread pattern already exists pre-change in packages/docs/src/view/clipboard.ts:430, so this is a repeated idiom rather than a new class of bug, which is why confidence is low.

samples.summary: Test-only backdoor `_setSelectionForTest` is on the shipped production `EditorAPI` and is widened here to inject arbitrary `tableCellRange` state
samples.evidence: The diff broadens `_setSelectionForTest(range: DocRange | null)` so a caller can now inject a full `tableCellRange` (arbitrary, unvalidated `rowIndex`/`colIndex`) into live selection state on the production API surface, not just in tests. I traced the consumer: `visitCellRectangleSlices` (packages/docs/src/model/range-slices.ts:53-59) now clamps rows/cols to the table's real dimensions and null-checks each cell, so injected out-of-range or negative indices are contained and I could not turn this into an out-of-bounds read or write. It also crosses no trust boundary — anyone able to call it already has script execution in the page. Reported only as a hygiene note: shipping test hooks that mutate editor state in the production bundle grows the reachable state space for any future consumer that trusts the range shape.
